## Design

### 2026-10-11 – I downloaded KiCad, and started on the guide for week one: Starbie. I learned how to set up a schematic, add wires, add footprints, and eventually, make my own PCB. There was a huge learning curve for

**5h**

I downloaded KiCad, and started on the guide for week one: Starbie. I learned how to set up a schematic, add wires, add footprints, and eventually, make my own PCB. There was a huge learning curve for me, especially since I had never used anything like KiCad or coded in C++ before. Because of these things, I learned a whole lot, even though I joined this week a little later (the last day, today).
